text: Separate from the folder being indexed (/Users/user/Library/Application Support/ACTIVATE Studio/kb/engineering-library), whose files are never written to by indexing.
Set STUDIO_INDEX_DIR in the Studio's environment to keep it elsewhere.
Log GUFI commands: every command run to read an index, with when it ran, what asked for it, how long it took, how it ended, and the end of its error output
